title: Marketplace pre-submission clearinghouse & launch gating for AWS/Azure/GCP
creator: Jordan Park
description: Coordinated pre-submission and launch gating process to ensure AWS Marketplace, Azure Marketplace, and GCP Marketplace listings meet legal, technical, and commercial requirements before go-live. This ticket stands up a 'clearinghouse' workflow: a checklist and a single review gate that aggregates inputs from Legal, Billing, Engineering, PM, Design, Docs, and Solutions. Goal: prevent late-stage rejections that delay launches or cause rollback, and provide a single status for go/no-go in the release calendar.
acceptance_criteria: One consolidated pre-submission checklist exists for AWS/Azure/GCP and is accessible to all stakeholders
Legal sign-off artifact (master EULA + marketplace-specific disclosures) uploaded to Confluence and linked in the checklist
Billing/SKU configuration validated by Finance and test purchase flows executed in each marketplace sandbox
Localization assets (localized descriptions, screenshots, and support contact) present for target regions and reviewed by Localization
All marketplace-specific metadata (entitlements, terms, pricing tier mapping) reviewed and recorded in the checklist
Launch gate meeting scheduled with required approvers and a recorded go/no-go decision stored in the ticket

notes: Risk: marketplace rejections typically come from missing legal disclosures or incorrect SKU entitlements; primary mitigation is the single pre-submission gate with mandatory checkboxes and owner sign-offs. If any marketplace requires a blocking fix after sign-off, follow rollback runbook and notify customers via status page and release notes.
